methodology.unit: One distinct HTTP method + OpenAPI path; query variants and export types are not additional endpoints.
methodology.full: Narrow endpoint has explicit transport, all documented inputs, operational caller and meaningful outcome/projection. Static audit, not a claim of current production activation.
methodology.partial: Real transport or intentional compatibility slice exists but parameters, lifecycle, domain model, supported export kinds or serving-mode parity are incomplete. Raw gateway support alone counts partial.
methodology.absent: No explicit integration in the centralized egress/caller families. A coincidental wildcard match or alternate Hub/OnlyFans feature is not endpoint support.
methodology.intentional exclusion: Two provider-internal callbacks and one explicitly deprecated scrape operation. Other deferred features remain absent, not retroactively declared intentional.
